title: Describing Shoulder pain to a Clinician

Triggers: overhead reaching, lifting, carrying on the affected side, sleeping on that side, and long periods of desk work with the arm forward. What helps or worsens: resting the painful motion for a short period, gentle pain-free movement of the arm, warmth once fresh soreness settles, and a cloth-wrapped cold pack briefly when soreness is fresh. Bring the note itself rather than a summary from memory, since the note preserves the exact words, dates, and sequence that memory smooths over.
